gi-0Ld2.title: Coverage: Christmas decorations
gi-0Ld2.summary: All coverage was taken in December, so many streets show Christmas decorations.

gi-4qh7.title: Google car: long antenna, silver tip
gi-4qh7.summary: Gen 3 car with a long antenna topped by a silver tip, known as the 'Gibraltar antenna'. Parts of Spain have it too, but nowhere else in Europe, and not near here.

gi-9WAS.title: Plate: white front, yellow back
gi-9WAS.summary: White front plates and yellow back plates, just like the UK. Remember the cars drive on the right.

gi-DOTU.title: Animals: wild monkeys
gi-DOTU.summary: Barbary macaque monkeys live wild here. It is the only place in Europe with wild monkeys.

gi-H71R.title: Landscape: tiny territory at Spain's border
gi-H71R.summary: A British Overseas Territory at the southern tip of Iberia, bordering Spain. For country streaks it counts as the United Kingdom.

differs.how: Spain is much larger and drives on the right without UK plates

gi-Qaw3.title: Driving side: right, despite UK plates
gi-Qaw3.summary: Traffic drives on the right, unlike the UK. UK-style plates plus right-hand traffic points here.

gi-d95Z.title: Houses: pastel, green or blue louvered shutters
gi-d95Z.summary: Fairly dense pastel buildings with louvered shutters (horizontal wooden slats), usually painted green, blue or brown, like other Mediterranean places.

gi-iBNT.title: Landscape: huge white limestone rock
gi-iBNT.summary: A massive limestone mountain with exposed white rock and a distinct shape towers over everything.

gi-iUcf.title: Language: English in a Mediterranean setting
gi-iUcf.summary: English on official signs with a Mediterranean look is a good hint. Malta also uses English and has a similar feel.

gi-sCLF.title: Landmark: mosque with two minarets, far south
gi-sCLF.summary: Near the southern tip you can see the minarets of the Ibrahim-al-Ibrahim Mosque, the southernmost mosque in continental Europe.
